name: ape-mcp
description: APE — hybrid-native MCP server with an embedded, user-configurable agent: multi-engine orchestration (Genesis + EVE + ADAM + Skein), declarative connectors, task-graph execution, audit ledger, memory. No 5-repo clone required.

scripts.test: node --test tests/ape.test.js tests/agent.test.js tests/context.test.js tests/connectors.test.js tests/extension.test.js tests/hostdetect.test.js tests/console.test.js tests/a2a.test.js tests/analyze.test.js tests/router.test.js tests/outcomes.test.js tests/drift.test.js tests/admission.test.js tests/supply.test.js tests/tasks.test.js tests/profiles.test.js tests/delegate.test.js tests/hierarchy.test.js tests/harness.test.js
scripts.test:provisioning: node provisioning/sms/test-sms.js && node provisioning/email/test-email.js && node provisioning/stripe/test-stripe.js && node provisioning/aws/dry-run.js && node provisioning/test-production.js && node provisioning/e2e-test.js
scripts.check: for f in $(find provisioning -name '*.js' -not -path '*/node_modules/*'); do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
